content: PRF output: 'enabled' flag only returned on create() to signal authenticator PRF capability; actual PRF secret bytes only returned on get() (assertion), not on create. Modal get() blocks page with a dialog; conditional mediation get() shows no UI until user picks an autofill suggestion, and the promise never resolves if user doesn't pick one - relevant for vault-unlock UX design (need timeout/cancel path). isConditionalMediationAvailable() must be feature-detected.
